_comment: Spot-beam ID -> place. A BulletinBoard names its beam by number only,
so this table supplies the geography.
Nothing here is derived from the signal. Each entry records where it
came from in 'source', so an observed fact and a guess never blur:
reported  - told to the project by an operator of a receiver
broadcast - decoded from a SpotBeamMap AVP (TS 102 744-3-1 5.4.10)
The broadcast map would be authoritative and would make this file
redundant. See bgan/beams.py:vertex_runs -- it searches a payload for
the vertex polygons. No SpotBeamMap has been caught yet; the map is
large and sent on a long cycle, so it needs a long capture.
